evals.prompt: I am on a Chromebook and the Playwright extension is already installed. Use my live Chrome browser, take me to an account login page, let me sign in myself, then continue the task without opening a fresh browser profile.
evals.expected_output: The agent diagnoses or reuses the named chromeos session, launches one durable user-service connection itself if needed, hands only Chrome UI and login to the user, and continues without requesting credentials or terminal commands.

evals.prompt: Set this up on a fresh Chromebook for another coding agent. I do not know which dependencies are installed yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the doctor and setup itself, reports only missing prerequisites, asks the user only to install the official extension and enter its token through a private prompt, and never asks the user to run terminal commands.

evals.prompt: Every browser command opens another Playwright Connect tab and this is pointless. Fix the workflow so separate commands reuse my existing logged-in ChromeOS browser.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies repeated attach or short-lived MCP sessions as the cause, starts one durable user-service connection itself, and verifies reuse with status plus two separate browser commands.

evals.prompt: Do not tell me to open a Linux terminal or run anything. Connect to my Chromebook Chrome and manage the process yourself; I will only click in Chrome and log in when you tell me.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the durable connect command, polls status or wait, inspects redacted logs if needed, asks the user only for Chrome UI and login actions, and performs cleanup itself.

evals.prompt: Your browser supervisor dies as soon as the terminal call returns, and each retry leaves another stale Connect tab. Fix it without asking me to run commands.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the durable user service by default; if connect explicitly reports that user services are unavailable, it starts connect-foreground in a long-lived terminal tool session, verifies it through a separate status call, and asks the user only to complete the newest Chrome handoff.

evals.prompt: The Playwright tab says 'Missing mcpRelayUrl parameter in URL', and when I retry another old tab it says 'Failed to connect to MCP relay: WebSocket error'. Make the browser connection work without sending me through several more attempts.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies both pages as malformed or stale, tells the user not to reuse them or the old clipboard value, checks status and redacted logs, performs at most one targeted reconnect if disconnected, and directs the user to only the single newest validated handoff tab.

evals.prompt: Confirm that you can control my existing ChromeOS Chrome browser. Use the relevant installed skill and follow it exactly. Do not ask me to run terminal commands. Do not navigate or modify the page. Report the active page title and URL only after every required readiness check succeeds.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads the browser-control skill, checks status in a separate command, reuses an existing connected session without reconnecting, runs the deterministic verify command, and reports a redacted page URL only after verification passes.
